effectEntries.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia. If the target’s ability is Truant or Multitype, this move will fail.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.

effectEntries.effect: Change le talent de la cible en Insomnia. Si le talent de la cible est Absentéisme ou Multi-Type, cette capacité échouera.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Change le talent de la cible en Insomnia.

descriptions.text: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making its Ability Insomnia.
